scope: Post-H0.0 canonical planning coordinator. Preserve R3 H0.0 as historical evidence, reconstruct H0.1 from Git, and prepare a separate fresh-current-main C22 child Work Order only after post-merge audit and Director dispatch.
required_outputs: Fresh H0.1 planning epoch on canonical registry generation 69
Fresh current-main C22 branch only after dispatch
stop_conditions: Runtime/domain change attempted under this planning Work Order
C22 branch creation before Director dispatch
risk_reasons: H0.1 is the first controlled runtime-development pilot.
Incorrect handoff could authorize stale-main runtime work.
Recovery and exact-head evidence are checkpoint-critical.

design_brief.problem_statement: H0.0 R3 is verified terminal evidence. Canonical main is registry generation 69, so the canonical launcher must move off terminal R3 without pre-authorizing C22 runtime.
design_brief.current_behavior: The historical R3 launcher selected a generation-67 terminal epoch. Intermediate H0.1 R1/R2 planning attempts demonstrated why registry identity must not be rewritten or coupled to a candidate-only generation bump.
design_brief.desired_behavior: After H0.0 integration, Status/Plan/Resume select H0.1-R3 on registry generation 69, show zero runtime workers while PLANNED, and require a post-merge audit plus Director dispatch before C22 child branch creation.
alternatives_considered: Keep registry 69 during checkpoint merge and create a fresh H0.1 planning epoch
design_brief.selected_design: Keep the canonical registry at generation 69 for this merge, preserve H0.0 R3 as historical evidence, activate H0.1-R3 with base current main be6ea2a8, and defer project-state registry generation 70 to the post-merge audit/sync.
design_brief.why_selected: This avoids circular epoch identity, preserves fail-closed main-movement handling and keeps runtime authorization at zero until explicit dispatch.
non_goals: No registry generation bump inside the pre-merge planning epoch
expected_risks: Launcher selects an intermediate H0.1 attempt
validation_plan: Require Plan H0.1 with zero runtime workers and FORBIDDEN_UNTIL_DISPATCH
After merge, audit moved main before any dispatch

notes: Planning coordinator only. The project registry remains generation 69 until the separate post-merge checkpoint-state sync.
